title.value: ANDES, the high resolution spectrograph for the ELT: science goals, project overview and future developments
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: ANDES, the high resolution spectrograph for the ELT: science goals, project overview and future developments

analysis.description: The paper presents an overview of the ANDES high-resolution spectrograph project for the European Extremely Large Telescope (ELT). It covers the project’s science goals, the instrument's design and technologies, and the consortium involved in its development. The paper details the scientific objectives, including studies of exoplanet atmospheres, stellar populations, galaxy formation, and fundamental physics. It also discusses the project's organization, cost estimates, and development schedule, aiming for a potential operation around 2032.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical research aspects in terms of experimental designs, project overviews, and scientific goals related to high-resolution spectroscopy.
type.quote: This paper provides a general description of the ANDES project, science and consortium.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on the ANDES spectrograph’s applications in astrophysical research, including areas such as exoplanets, stellar populations, and galactic studies.
name.quote: ANDES has a wide range of groundbreaking science cases spanning nearly all areas of research in astrophysics and even fundamental physics.

name.justification: The paper discusses detailed objectives regarding the characterization of exoplanet atmospheres, making it a significant sub-field.
name.quote: One of the primary scientific goals of ANDES is to characterize the atmospheres of small, rocky exoplanets in the habitable zone.

name.justification: The research involves understanding stellar population structures, including objectives related to the Galactic Bulge and First Stars.
name.quote: The study of stars and stellar populations is fundamental to understanding the formation and evolution of galaxies.

name.justification: The paper extensively covers this sub-field by addressing galaxy formation, the intergalactic medium, and the epoch of reionisation.
name.quote: The study of the reionisation epoch (EoR) is crucial for understanding the formation and evolution of the universe’s first structures.

name.justification: The spectrograph’s capability to probe cosmological phenomena like the Big Bang Nucleosynthesis makes it pertinent to this field.
name.quote: Spectroscopy has historically been a catalyst for significant advancements in fundamental physics.
